title: Jinrui wa Suitai Shimashita Specials
justification: AniList 15617 has 6 episodes (2012-09-19 to 2013-02-20); the offline database synonym is 'Humanity Has Declined: The Humans' Law of the Jungle'. AniDB 8276 S2-S7 are 'The Humans' Law of the Jungle #1..#6' on 2012-09-19, 10-17, 11-21, 12-19, 2013-01-16, 02-20. TVDB 259653 0x02-0x07 hold the same titles on the same dates (0x01 'The Humans' Fairy Note', 2012-10-28, is AniDB S1). Anime-Lists' own pairs shifted every special by one; overlay/8276.json in the worktree already repairs that, so with the overlay the bridge lands S2-S7 on 0x02-0x07 within a day each. S8 'Audio Commentary' and S9 'Studio Visit' are other items.
